title: AstroMycologySidecarMetadata
description: Standardized schema for AstroMycology calibration image sidecar metadata (both CSV row mapping and JSON list formats)

filename.description: The exact name of the image file, including extension (e.g. IMG_1212_cropped.jpg). Used as a primary key to match with physical image files.

species.description: Standard scientific or common name of the organism (e.g. Agaricus bisporus, Pleurotus ostreatus).

media_kind.description: What kind of media this row describes: an RGB photo, an RGB-thermal photo, a 3D scan (.ply/.obj/.glb/.gltf/.stl), or a video. Defaults to 'photo' when omitted.

genotype.description: Strain, isolate, cultivar, or accession identifier (e.g. a specific mushroom strain ID).

treatment.description: The experimental treatment, growth condition, or substrate applied (e.g. substrate A, Control, +Trichoderma, 1g).

glds_accession.description: The NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR) / GeneLab dataset accession ID (e.g. OSD-670).

experiment.description: Name or unique ID of the biological experiment (e.g. APEX03, SpaceChile).

date_taken.description: ISO 8601 formatted datetime string indicating when the photograph was taken (e.g. 2026-07-31T16:17:09Z).

camera.description: Camera model, hardware, or device identifier used for capture.

lighting.description: Lighting conditions under which the image was taken (e.g. LED White, FL, Dark, Red grow-light).

scale_bar_mm.description: Physical size of the scale reference in millimeters.

calibration_marker.description: Whether a fiducial + colour-chip calibration card (recycled from the AstroBotany project) is present in the frame.

width_px.description: The width of the image in pixels.

height_px.description: The height of the image in pixels.

notes.description: Free text comments, annotations, or observations.

source_repo.description: URL or owner/repo identifier of the origin repository (e.g. dr-richard-barker/image-analysis-software-and-R-codes).

source_path.description: Subdirectory path of the image folder inside the origin repository (e.g. Londultia).

contributor.description: Name of the scientist, classroom, or citizen scientist who contributed the image data.

license.description: Creative Commons or open-source data license covering the image (e.g. CC0-1.0, CC-BY-4.0).
